trusted_external_entities.name: Block Producer
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Entity producing new blocks with excess_blob_gas header field. Authenticated via consensus mechanism (PoS) but header values must still be validated against calculation rules.

trusted_external_entities.name: Precompile Caller
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Contract or EOA calling the BLAKE2 F precompile at address 0x09. All input data is untrusted; strict validation of 213-byte length and final flag value required.

trusted_external_entities.name: Proposal Author
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Developer or researcher submitting an improvement proposal. Authors are authenticated through the proposal process but proposals undergo classification and review by editors.

trusted_external_entities.name: Documentation User
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Developer or researcher accessing EIP/ERC documentation. URL requests are untrusted but serve read-only content; redirects handle legacy URL migration.

trusted_external_entities.name: EIP Author
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Developer or researcher proposing an Ethereum improvement for hard fork inclusion. Authenticated through ACD process but proposals require rough consensus from Core Developers.

trusted_external_entities.name: User or Dapp
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External entity submitting a Type 1 transaction for signing. Transaction data is untrusted but wallet performs automatic conversion to Type 2 format.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Block header excess_blob_gas must match calculated value using updated formula. Invalid headers are rejected to prevent consensus violations.
Input must be exactly 213 bytes. Final flag must be 0 or 1. Invalid inputs cause precompile to fail and consume all gas. Rounds parameter determines gas cost.
Proposal scope is classified by editors to route to correct repository (EIP vs ERC). Classification based on whether change affects core protocol or application layer.
Server checks if URL is for migrated ERC and issues redirect to ercs.ethereum.org. Read-only access to documentation with no security-sensitive operations.
EIP advances through governance process requiring rough consensus at AllCoreDevs calls. Conceptual support, implementation willingness, and documentation required for eligibility.
Wallet automatically converts Type 1 to Type 2 transactions. Access list preserved, gas_price mapped to max_fee_per_gas and max_priority_fee_per_gas.
